== Description ==

[[Mike Kessling]] (left, blue T-shirt and black shorts) at a table with [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (back center) and [[Greg Shaw]] (right, red Take October hoodie) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
